mission.title: Military Action
mission.description: Bring the Merovingian's terms to the commandos and lead their squad against the rebel Exiles.

npc.say: I do have a reason, soldier: because you whine like a baby!
You have done well, {player}. I am certain that the Merovingian is pleased with your loyalty.

phase.briefing:
I have news, {player}. The Merovingian has decided to agree with the commando's proposal, if they meet his request: aid us in the removal and permanent eradication of the recent uprising of rebelling Exiles. You must bring this news to Carson.
If you can help it, do try and avoid getting shot. Our messengers do not perform so well when their blood is replaced with bullets.

enter.say: It looks like Carson is accompanied by two other commandos. Let's hope they don't try anything funny.

talk.say:
The Frenchman wants our help? Typical. I didn't think it'd be any different. Freakin' pansies... We can back up any claim we make. I have no problem with killing to make friends.
Here's the score: I have two men prepared to engage on your rebels, they just need a captain to lead them into the hotspot. Tell your wine-sipping friend that he can find my men in sector 7-G. Their call signs are Stephens and Pemberton. Got that?

done.say:
I'm surprised. It seems the commandos are actually willing to help.
Hmm, Sector 7-G? I don't have that exact location, but it's nearby. I hope Flood has the details.
Sector seven G! You got that, soldier?! Pick up those gun bunnies and kill some rebels!

phase.briefing:
Things proceed according to plan. Excellent.
Stephens and Pemberton are awaiting you at the next location.

enter.say: I've confirmed the signals of Stephens and Pemberton. Get in there and pick up the commandos.

talk.say: We're cocked, locked and ready to rock.

objective.text: Lead Stephens and Pemberton out of the area

complete.say: I wonder if two commandos is going to be enough for the assault... Think you can handle it?

phase.briefing:
Now that the cattle are in tow, lead them to the abattoir.
Revenge is costly, but thankfully it won't cost us quite as much as before.

enter.say:
I'm seeing quite a few signals on that lot. I think you'll need all the help you can get for this suicide mission.
Good luck in there!

objective.text: Kill all of the rebel Exiles

done.say:
You did it! That was some serious ass kicking back there!
Don't worry about the commandos. Just lead the defectors to safety.

talk.say: We will come quietly and return to the Merovingian's fold. We have seen the error of our ways.
I shall never betray the Merovingian again.

objective.text: Lead Rasalgethi and Aurelio out of the area

near.say: It seems that we have a pair of defectors on our hands. Maybe the Merovingian will actually want them back. Clear out the area of remaining hostiles and pick 'em up. I'll update Flood.

complete.say: I like where this is going, but my only fear is that the Merovingian will refuse the continued service of the defectors. More often than not, Exiles are not brought back into the Merovingian's fold.

phase.briefing: Lead the two traitors to Alpha and Xinjiang.

enter.say:
I pulled up some intel on your contacts. Check this out: Alpha and Xinjiang are the Merovingian's personal chateau guards.
I think this spells trouble for Rasalgethi and Aurelio.

objective.text: Lead Rasalgethi and Aurelio to Alpha and Xinjiang

done.say: You have done well, {player}, but we cannot let Rasalgethi live!
No surprise there. The Merovingian doesn't take chances -- unless it's Persephone.

mission.finish:
I am terribly concerned about the state of Desayd. In fact, I have a theory that I will share with you -- only because I hate to see that confused look on your face. It's quite unattractive.
If my sources are correct, Desayd has tapped into the ability to create copies of himself. Taking him down will not prove to be a simple task. Stay prepared, {player}.
